## Open questions

* How do long-context large language models reduce hallucinations, and what specific experiments or research show improvements in factual consistency when context is extended? These questions cannot be addressed by the provided source, which is a neuroscience research article investigating the role of VGLUT3 expression in mouse fear memory [^crossref:10.1523/eneuro.0304-22.2023.f5-1]. 
* What would settle these questions? Conducting a comprehensive literature search for AI and machine learning research papers specifically evaluating long-context language models, factual consistency, and hallucination reduction metrics.
